statewide.capNote: Each district file is capped at 2,000 transformers. Totals are SAMPLE totals, not the full KSEB DTR population.

quality.unknownClassNote: All 7 Unknown class rows also had missing %; 5 in Kasaragod, 2 in Thiruvananthapuram. Retained and % imputed from balance/cap.
quality.formulaMismatchNote: Almost all mismatches are overloaded DTRs where issued+connected > 90% cap and source floors balance at 0. Retained as Very Low / saturated. Not removed.
quality.boundaryNote: Exact 25/50/75% values sometimes labelled in the lower class. Source class retained.
quality.districtNameWrap: Thiruvananthapuram wrapped as THIRUVANANTHAPU RAM in PDF; normalised.
quality.kasaragodSpelling: Source files use KASARGODE; report uses standard Kasaragod.
quality.sampleCap: Every district file is exactly 2,000 transformers. This is a generator cap, not a complete DTR census. Larger urban districts are geographically truncated (e.g. Ernakulam sample has 13 electrical sections; Thiruvananthapuram has 21).
quality.adminMismatch: KSEB electrical sections do not always match revenue districts (e.g. Thodupuzha sections appear under Ernakulam in the source file). Analysis follows the source district label.

dictionary.name: District
dictionary.desc: KSEB report district label (electrical admin, not always revenue district).
dictionary.limits: Name wrapping and Kasargode spelling; electrical ≠ revenue boundary.

dictionary.name: Section
dictionary.desc: KSEB electrical section name with numeric section code.
dictionary.limits: Not a panchayat/municipality. Cannot be joined to LSG census without a crosswalk (unavailable).

dictionary.name: Transformer
dictionary.limits: Names are operational nicknames, not consumer IDs. Useful as location clues (HOTEL, SCHOOL) but not a customer list.

dictionary.name: 90% Cap (kW)
dictionary.desc: 90% of DTR capacity — the hosting-capacity ceiling used by KSEB for RE feasibility.
dictionary.limits: Already 90% of nameplate. Typical DTR sizes cluster at 20, 81, 129, 202 kW (corresponding to 25/100/160/250 kVA class at ~0.9 pf).

dictionary.name: Issued (kW)
dictionary.desc: Solar capacity sanctioned / registration issued but not necessarily commissioned.
dictionary.limits: May include cancelled or delayed registrations. Not equal to installed capacity.

dictionary.name: Connected (kW)
dictionary.desc: Solar capacity already connected on that DTR.
dictionary.limits: Best available proxy for existing rooftop solar on the transformer. Not household counts.

dictionary.name: Balance (kW)
dictionary.desc: Remaining connectable RE capacity on the DTR after issued + connected.
dictionary.limits: Floored at 0 when issued+connected exceeds 90% cap. This is GRID HEADROOM, not rooftop area or customer willingness.

dictionary.name: Balance %
dictionary.limits: High % can mean either unused opportunity or weak local demand.

dictionary.name: Class
dictionary.desc: Feasibility band: Very High / High / Medium / Low / Very Low / Unknown.
dictionary.limits: Observed cut-points: Very High ≥75%, High 50–<75, Medium 25–<50, Low 10–<25, Very Low <10. Boundary labels occasionally inconsistent.
